title: Pretty Linear Liars: Unregularized Probes Favor Intervention-Unfaithful Features
abstract: arXiv:2611.20371v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear probing is a common technique in mechanistic interpretability despite the fact that the decodability of a given feature does not necessarily imply the network uses that feature. Intervention faithfulness, not merely decodability, is the appropriate criterion for whether a feature serves a defined active role in the model. Meanwhile, probe regularization has been used for feature discovery, but the impact of regularization on feature causality remains unclear. We study probe regularization systematically, starting with unregularized ordinary least squares (OLS) regression and considering increasing amounts of regularization via ridge regression. We show theoretically that OLS probes amplify low-variance directions in activation space that have spurious correlations with the target feature, whereas regularization reduces influence from these directions. translated_title: 漂亮的线性骗子：无正则化探针偏爱干预不忠实的特征
translated_abstract: 线性探针是机械可解释性研究中的一种常用技术，然而某个特征的可解码性并不一定意味着网络确实使用了该特征。干预忠实性，而非仅仅可解码性，才是判断一个特征是否在模型中发挥实际作用的标准。与此同时，探针正则化已被用于特征发现，但正则化对特征因果性的影响仍不清楚。我们系统地研究了探针正则化，从无正则化的普通最小二乘（OLS）回归开始，并考察通过岭回归逐步增加正则化强度的效果。我们从理论上证明，OLS探针会放大激活空间中与目标特征存在虚假相关性的低方差方向，而正则化能够降低这些方向的影响。在实验上，我们在玩具transformer和Llama-2-7B中发现，干预忠实性……
tldr: 无正则化的线性探针会放大激活空间中与目标特征虚假相关的低方差方向，从而偏向“可解码但干预不忠实”的特征，而适当正则化（如岭回归）可以缓解这一问题、提升特征因果忠实性。
en_tdlr: Unregularized OLS probes amplify low-variance spurious directions in activation space, favoring intervention-unfaithful features, while regularization (e.g., ridge) improves the causal faithfulness of discovered features.
